brief: CUSTOMER.REC card portrait for Sable Okonkwo (customers.ts: Kestrel courier drone, dominant redirect, tiers 1-2), matching the existing Dex Marlowe card portrait's exact construction (ui-demos/kpos-shell/art/dex-portrait.png / card.html): a three-quarter headshot, direct gaze, 1990s anime OVA ink style, flat cel shading, no text or speech bubbles or panel borders or lettering anywhere in the frame. She reads as a working courier: practical short hair, a collared work jacket with a courier-service look (no legible logo or lettering), a tired but sharp expression, the face of someone who has re-flown the same wrong route twice this week and is done being polite about it. Background a plain soft dark gradient only, no scene detail competing with the face. NOTE: no appearance canon exists yet for this customer; this order waits on the loremaster's ruling on customer figure likenesses before art-lead spends any credits on it.
